faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), located in Manipal, Karnataka, to fill project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being offered?
faq.answer: The post being offered under this recruitment drive is Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) within the Radiodiagnosis department at KMC, Manipal.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering (Medical Imaging Technology), Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000 plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application along with detailed CV and supporting documents via email is October 12, 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to send their applications via email directly to the designated official email address provided by the institution.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates send their application email?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their complete applications and supporting documents to the official recruitment email address: [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, meaning candidates can apply for the post without any fee payment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their CV and qualifications, followed by a personal or technical interview.
